items.title: RESCIND – 44 O’SHAUGHNESSY BUS STOP Woodside Avenue, south side, 120 feet west of Portola Drive (Supervisor District 7, 8) (Approvable by the Transit Planning Manager) Edgar Orozco, [staff email removed — see the order] To decrease travel time on the 44 O’Shaughnessy and reduce the number of times buses stop at the intersection, SFMTA recommends discontinuing service at bus stop ID#16938 on Woodsi
items.decision: Approved by the Transit Planning Manager for implementation.
items.comments: Several comments received in opposition. Concerns raised regarding challenges for pedestrians crossing Portola if stop was removed. Suggestion made to eliminate the Ulloa stop instead.
items.text:
14. RESCIND – 44 O’SHAUGHNESSY BUS STOP



Woodside Avenue, south side, 120 feet west of Portola Drive (Supervisor District 7, 8) (Approvable by
the Transit Planning Manager) Edgar Orozco, [staff email removed — see the order]

To decrease travel time on the 44 O’Shaughnessy and reduce the number of times buses stop at the
intersection, SFMTA recommends discontinuing service at bus stop ID#16938 on Woodside Avenue,
west of Portola Drive, given its proximity to bus stop ID#15834 on O’Shaughnessy Boulevard, east of
Portola Drive, which will remain in service.

Public Comments: Several comments received in opposition. Concerns raised regarding challenges
for pedestrians crossing Portola if stop was removed. Suggestion made to eliminate the Ulloa stop
instead.
Decision: Approved by the Transit Planning Manager for implementation.
